title: gentiana sino-ornata f. saxatilis
intro: Gentiana sino-ornata f. saxatilis, commonly known as a variety of the ornate gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat digestive issues, fever, and coughs. The health benefits of Gentiana sino-ornata f. saxatilis include its anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarin, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
